Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The Pakistan players are out in the middle. Tinashe Kamunhukamwe and Wesley Madhevere will open the innings for Zimbabwe. Mohammad Hasnain will start the proceedings for Pakistan.

The total is a competitive one. Pakistan have the bowlers to defend it and the wicket is aiding the pacers a touch but still a decent one to bat on. If Zimbabwe bat sensibly, they can chase this down. Join us in a bit!

The Pakistan batting never got going. Except for Rizwan, nobody got used to the pace of the wicket. Rizwan though could have been dismissed earlier had his catch been taken. He though made most of the opportunity and has take Pakistan to a fighting total.

After electing to field, their bowlers managed to take wickets at regular intervals. Whenever, Pakistan looked to get going, they managed to strike. Jongwe and Madhevere were the pick but it was an overall effort from their bowlers.
A superb finish to the innings and it has given Pakistan a really good total on the board! However, one has to feel, Zimbabwe will be the happier side of the two.

Done and dusted with the national anthems. We are all set to begin. The Zimbabwe players are out in the middle. Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan will open the innings for Pakistan. Wellington Masakadza will start the proceedings for Zimbabwe.
Time for the national anthems of both the teams. Pakistan's is first followed by Zimbabwe.

Pakistan skipper, Babar Azam says that they would have bowled first. Adds that there is some moisture on this wicket. Mentions that they have a good momentum coming into this series. Further says that Danish Aziz makes his T20I debut for them.
Zimbabwe skipper, Sean Williams says they will bowl first. Adds that they had good preparations in the domestic tournament. Mentions that the wicket will flatten after the first innings.

Pitch Report - Tino Mawoyo is down for the pitch report. He says that there is no green grass on the surface. Adds that the conditions are good for cricket. Mentions that the team which bats first average score is 160-plus. Further says that the seamers will get some help from the surface.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Tinashe Kamunhukamwe, Wesley Madhevere, Tadiwanashe Marumani, Craig Ervine, Sean Williams (C), Ryan Burl, Regis Chakabva (WK), Luke Jongwe, Wellington Masakadza, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.
Pakistan (Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Mohammad Hafeez, Haider Ali, Danish Aziz, Faheem Ashraf, Mohammad Nawaz, Usman Qadir, Mohammad Hasnain, Haris Rauf.
TOSS - It is time for the spin of the coin. Both the captains are out in the middle. Zimbabwe win the toss and elect to field first!

It is time for the first T20I between Pakistan and Zimbabwe. The visitors are expected to win all three but knowing the hosts, they won’t let it easy. However, it will be nothing more than a surprise if they do manage to pull off a victory. Toss and teams in a bit.
